ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag on the driver — the wait fell 30 s short of the 3-minute threshold, but the tap was genuine and within the pickup radius.

rejected_claims.reason: The tap itself does not establish the fee: NS-1 requires all three of (i) tap, (ii) GPS presence and (iii) more than 3 minutes of waiting, and the tap at 14:13:10 was followed by only 1 min 40 s inside the radius before cancellation, so (iii) fails on the system record [F6][F10][NS-1].

The 30-second shortfall is decisive, not a technicality: NS-1(iii) sets a hard threshold of more than 3 minutes, and the system record gives 2 min 30 s within the radius and only 2 min 0 s stationary before the 14:14:50 cancellation, so NS-2 refunds the fee [F2][F3][F4][NS-1][NS-2].
The driver's $4.50 split is irrelevant to the rider's liability; NS-2 makes the full $6.61 refundable once NS-1's conditions are unmet, regardless of how the fee is apportioned [F8][F4][NS-2][NS-7].

Clean profile history does not cure the failed condition: profile facts never decide a case, and NS-1(iii) is measured from the GPS and timeline records, which show a wait below the threshold [F16][F17][F2][NS-1].
